description: Add the SHARED pure, deterministic domain logic for battle enhancements and its unit tests. This is the foundation both backend and frontend consume: a Difficulty type, a BattleRecord type (wins/losses/draws + current win streak) added as an OPTIONAL field on Monster (backward compatible, mirroring how #42 added `affection`), deterministic enemy generation keyed by (playerStage, difficulty, seed), difficulty-scaled reward calculation, and a record-update helper. simulateBattle's log line format is NOT changed. No frontend/backend wiring in this feature.
steps: In packages/shared/src/types.ts: add `export type Difficulty = "easy" | "normal" | "hard";` with a doc comment mapping to 弱い/普通/強い. Add `export interface BattleRecord { wins: number; losses: number; draws: number; streak: number; }` (streak = current win streak). Add an OPTIONAL field to Monster: `/** Cumulative battle record (issue #41). OPTIONAL on legacy pre-#41 saves; defaulted via battleRecordOf/normalizeBattleRecord on load. */ battleRecord?: BattleRecord;`. Extend BattleRequest to carry optional difficulty+seed used over the wire: add `monsterId?: string; difficulty?: Difficulty;` alongside the existing optional `seed?: number` (keep existing player/enemy fields for type back-compat; they are unused by the new POST body).

Create packages/shared/src/battle-enhancements.ts (new module) OR add to game.ts a cohesive block. Prefer a NEW module packages/shared/src/battle-enhancements.ts that imports from stages.ts/types.ts/game.ts, to keep battle.ts (the sim) untouched. Export the following pure functions:

DIFFICULTY constants: an exported record of per-difficulty tuning, single source of truth, e.g. `DIFFICULTY_CONFIG: Record<Difficulty, { enemyScale: number; rewardAtk: number; rewardDef: number; labelKey?: string }>`. Suggested values: easy enemyScale 0.75 reward atk+1/def+1; normal enemyScale 0.95 reward atk+1/def+1 (matches current behavior baseline closely) ... actually set normal to atk+1/def+1 to preserve today's win reward, easy smaller (atk+1,def+0), hard larger (atk+2,def+2). Document the chosen numbers in comments; the coder may pick clean numbers but MUST keep them the single source of truth and MUST make hard reward strictly greater than normal, and normal strictly greater-or-equal easy (強い相手ほど上昇が大きい).

generateEnemy(playerStage: GrowthStage, difficulty: Difficulty, seed: number): Monster — deterministic. Base the enemy on getStage(playerStage).baseStats scaled by DIFFICULTY_CONFIG[difficulty].enemyScale, with a small seed-derived jitter via a local mulberry32-style RNG (reuse the createRng approach; you may export createRng from battle.ts or re-implement a tiny local one) so the SAME (stage,difficulty,seed) always yields the SAME enemy. Stats clamped to sane non-negative integers (atk>=1, def>=0, maxHp>=1, hp=maxHp). Enemy id like `enemy-${difficulty}-${playerStage}`. stageId = playerStage (so the frontend reuses the stage sprite). name = a localizable base; store a JA name consistent with the existing `野生の{label}モンスター` convention but difficulty-prefixed, e.g. the function returns a monster whose `name` is the JA string `${difficultyLabelJa} 野生の${stage.labelJa}モンスター` (弱い/普通/強い prefix). The FRONTEND will render its own localized display name via i18n; the Monster.name here is the server/JA canonical. Include trainingCount/careCounters/bornAt/lastUpdatedAt/isSleeping/dirty/hungryLevel defaults like buildEnemy does.

battleReward(difficulty: Difficulty, won: boolean): { atk: number; def: number } — returns the stat deltas to apply on the given outcome. On a loss returns {atk:0,def:0}. On a win returns the per-difficulty reward from DIFFICULTY_CONFIG. Pure, no RNG.

battleRecordOf(monster: Monster): BattleRecord — returns the monster's record, defaulting a missing/undefined/partial one to {wins:0,losses:0,draws:0,streak:0} and coercing non-finite members to 0 (mirror affectionOf's defensive defaulting). normalizeBattleRecord(monster: Monster): Monster — returns a NEW monster whose battleRecord is battleRecordOf(monster) (idempotent; used on the load path like normalizeAffection).

recordBattleOutcome(monster: Monster, winner: BattleWinner, now?: number): Monster — returns a NEW monster (cloneMonster-style, never mutate input) with battleRecord updated: winner==="player" increments wins and streak; winner==="enemy" increments losses and resets streak to 0; winner==="draw" increments draws and resets streak to 0 (document the draw-resets-streak choice). Also bumps lastUpdatedAt to `now`. This does NOT touch stats/affection; the handler composes it with battleReward + recordBattleWinAffection.
Export all new functions/types from packages/shared/src/index.ts (the barrel re-exports battle-enhancements.ts; add the line).

Update validateMonster in packages/shared/src/game.ts to ACCEPT battleRecord as optional-with-default, mirroring the existing `affection` block: if m.battleRecord is undefined/null -> accept (legacy); if present it must be an object whose wins/losses/draws/streak (when present) are finite numbers, else reject. Keep JA/behavior of all other validation unchanged. Add a comment referencing issue #41 and the #42 precedent.
Also default battleRecord on createMonster in game.ts so fresh monsters carry a zeroed record (import/define the zero record; keep affection defaulting as-is).

Create packages/shared/src/__tests__/battle-enhancements.test.ts (node:test + assert/strict, same style as battle.test.ts). Cover: (a) generateEnemy is deterministic — same (stage,difficulty,seed) deep-equals; different seed OR different difficulty can differ; (b) EVERY difficulty branch of generateEnemy produces valid stats and that hard enemy is stronger than easy for the same stage/seed (document via atk+def+maxHp sum comparison); (c) battleReward for every difficulty on win returns the configured deltas and hard>=normal>=easy for atk+def total, and on loss returns zeros; (d) recordBattleOutcome: a player win increments wins and streak; a loss increments losses and zeroes streak; a draw increments draws and zeroes streak; input is not mutated; (e) battleRecordOf defaults a monster with NO battleRecord to all-zeros and coerces a partial/NaN record defensively; normalizeBattleRecord is idempotent; (f) validateMonster accepts a monster with battleRecord ABSENT (legacy) and one with a valid record, and REJECTS one whose battleRecord member is a non-finite number/string.
Run shared tests and the build.
acceptance_criteria: packages/shared/src/battle-enhancements.ts exports generateEnemy, battleReward, recordBattleOutcome, battleRecordOf, normalizeBattleRecord, DIFFICULTY_CONFIG, and these are re-exported from index.ts.
types.ts has Difficulty and BattleRecord and Monster.battleRecord?; BattleRequest carries optional monsterId/difficulty/seed.
simulateBattle and its log line format in battle.ts are unchanged.
validateMonster accepts legacy monsters lacking battleRecord and rejects a malformed one; createMonster seeds a zeroed record.
generateEnemy is deterministic for a fixed (stage,difficulty,seed) and a hard enemy is stronger than an easy one; battleReward scales hard>=normal>=easy and is zero on loss.
New shared test file passes; total shared test count increases above 75 and `npm test` is fully green.
